title: Uniqueness of integral pullback tensor unit coherence
statement: Any two isomorphisms satisfying both prescribed integral pullback tensor unitor equations are equal by cancellation after faithful coherent reduction.

proof.text: Apply coherent reduction to the left and right equations for two candidates, cancel the invertible comparison and unitors in the reduced monoidal category, and reflect equality through faithful coherent reduction.
